QuestInfo.name: Sulfur and Iron - The Blaster's Path
QuestInfo.0: You decide to become a member of the Resistance in order to fight for peace and freedom. Resistance members can choose from various Jobs to fit their aptitude and taste... You wonder what Jobs are available. Talk to #b#p2151000##k, the Blaster Job Instructor, who works as a kindergarten teacher, to find out more about being a Blaster.
QuestInfo.1:
The #bBlaster#k is a melee brawler who combines martial arts skills with technical innovation. Blasters alternate between dynamic melee strikes and blasts from their piercing Arm Cannons! Speak to #p2151000# again if you want to become a Blaster.

#bIf you want to become a different Job, forfeit the quest and talk to another Job Instructor.#k
QuestInfo.2: You are now a Blaster! Show your courage as a member of the Resistance by standing on the front lines in the battle against the Black Wings!

0.0: Heya. Surprised? The base looks pretty unassuming from the outside. I guess I should probably re-introduce myself. I'm #p2151000#. When I'm not yelling at kindergarteners to get things out of their mouths, I'm the Resistance's Blaster trainer. What do you mean you can't believe I'm a teacher? Listen, those kids may be smelly and loud, and have terrible manners, but that's precisely why they need good role models like me!
0.1: You haven't heard of #bBlaster#k? Of course not, they're a Resistance secret! Blasters are the perfect balance of form and function. Skilled, muscular martial artists wielding a powerful mechanical weapon that's part gauntlet, part gun. We use our firepower to break through the defenses of heavily armored foes.
0.2: Using our handy-dandy Arm Cannons, our swift punches pack extra firepower, in every sense of the word! Pow indeed.
0.3: Switching between quick melee strikes and deadly mid-range blasts isn't all sunshine and daisies though. Mastering your Arm Cannon is tough work. But after enough training, you'll be a mighty force to be reckoned with! The beauty of the Blaster is the merger of man and machine. We strike fast and hard. In the fight against the Black Wings, we're the first line of offense! So, think you're up for the challenge?

yes.0: Now wait just a sec, kiddo! We don't just hand out Arm Cannons to everyone who wants them. We've got limited resources here. A real Blaster needs to be capable of making split-second calls. You've gotta hit the enemy when they're open and know what skills are most appropriate in the moment. You think you're Blaster material? Sleep on it, and get back to me.

no.0: Fine with me. I don't have time to be training weaklings.
